data.title: The Fed Decides at 2 pm ET Wednesday. What a Hike Does to Bitcoin, XRP and Ethereum the Day After Congress Failed.
data.description: A Fed rate hike at 2 PM ET Wednesday will hit a crypto market already rattled by the Senate killing landmark digital asset legislation, but traders watching Bitcoin, XRP, and Ethereum may have their eyes on the wrong clock.
